subject: Workplace Skills
title: Your Online Presence
description: Learn Your Online Presence in one minute.

hook.text: Recruiters Google you before interviews. What they find — or don't — shapes their first impression.

buildup.text: An empty online presence suggests you're invisible. An outdated one suggests you don't care about details.

discovery.text: Google yourself. Update your LinkedIn headline, photo, and summary. They're your digital storefront.

twist.text: Your LinkedIn summary should sound like you, not a corporate brochure. Authentic voice attracts more than polish.

climax.text: Audit your online presence quarterly. Remove outdated info, add recent work, and ensure consistency across platforms.

punchline.text: Google yourself. Fix what you find. Repeat quarterly.

quiz.question: Why should you audit your online presence regularly?
options: Social media algorithms favor recently updated profiles
Recruiters search you online, and what they find shapes their first impression
